verdict.rationale: Whether an authenticator's client code is open source is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack says Authy's iOS, Android or desktop clients are open source or publicly inspectable. The only GitHub project mentioned (alexzorin/authy) is a third-party export tool, which is a user-side workaround, not the product's own source.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the client apps are open source, so the code handling my seeds can be inspected and community-reviewed
